note: meaningful tokens; tiled (rotated) and truncated to exactly `tokens`. Repetition fills length only and does not bias PREFILL OR PLAIN DECODE throughput, which are token-count and bandwidth bound. It does NOT hold for anything that drafts: this corpus has 65,536 tokens drawn from 682 distinct ids with 98.4% of bigrams repeated, and a draft head predicts it perfectly -- DFlash2 reports 100% acceptance at every draft count from 1 to 12 on it. Use a diverse workload for speculative measurements; scripts/sweeps/dflash2-draft-tokens-realtext.ps1 measures the serving path on generated prose instead.
